name: Loma Linda University Health Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Help at Loma Linda University Health. You do an interview, a first meeting and training for your program. Then you give about 2 hours a week.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. If you are 16 or 17, you need a GPA of 3.2 or higher. You cannot do this for school credit or for court-ordered service.
duration: At least 100 hours a year, about 2 hours a week
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The steps take about 2 weeks to a month.
how_to_apply: Apply online. If you are accepted, you get an email within 5 business days. Then you set up an interview and go to a 3-hour orientation.
notes: You need a TB check each year and a flu shot. Teens skip the background check. Questions: 909-558-8022 or volunteerservices@llu.edu. The office is at 11234 Anderson Street, Room 1802.
